# Agent Log

Chronological log of agent dispatches. Newest entries at the top.

Format:

```
## <timestamp> — <agent-name> — <finding-id or task>
- Branch: <branch-name or "none">
- PR: #<pr-number or "none">
- Status: opened | completed | blocked | superseded
- Files touched: <count>
- Notes: <free text>
```
